source_claim: In Nintendo's official Metroid Prime 3 interview, Nintendo and Retro Studios staff describe Dark Samus as a central character in the Metroid Prime storyline and discuss her return from Metroid Prime 2.
notes: This official interview identifies Dark Samus by name in the context of Metroid Prime 2 and Metroid Prime 3. Justin Bailey remains unproposed because this source does not address that name.
